बॉक्स ऑफिस पर फ़िल्म Ramayana का महा-तूफान जारी है! 🔥

नितेश तिवारी के निर्देशन में बनी रणबीर कपूर, यश और साई पल्लवी स्टारर फ़िल्म Ramayana ने रिलीज़ के 9वें दिन ₹604.27 करोड़ का शानदार कलेक्शन कर लिया है। 💥

Sacnilk की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, 5 नवंबर को रिलीज़ हुई इस फ़िल्म ने विक्की कौशल की फ़िल्म Chhaava के ₹601.57 करोड़ के लाइफटाइम कलेक्शन को पीछे छोड़ दिया है। 📈

इससे पहले यह फ़िल्म शाहरुख खान की Pathaan (₹544.28 करोड़) और रणबीर कपूर की पिछली फ़िल्म Animal (₹556.36 करोड़) का रिकॉर्ड भी तोड़ चुकी है। ✨

दशहरा पर शुरू हुई एडवांस बुकिंग से फ़िल्म ने रिलीज़ से पहले ही वर्ल्डवाइड ₹200 करोड़ कमा लिए थे, और सोमवार को ₹107 करोड़ नेट कलेक्शन करके इतिहास रचा था। 🚀

अब देखना यह है कि यह मेगा बजट फ़िल्म अपने दूसरे वीकेंड पर क्या नया कमाल करती है और ₹700 करोड़ का आंकड़ा पार करती है या नहीं। 🤩

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana जल्द ही ₹700 करोड़ का आंकड़ा पार कर पाएगी? अपनी राय कमेंट में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana box office collection day 9: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash-starrer crosses  ₹600 crore, beats lifetime haul of Chhaava
ctx.summary: Ramayana Part 1 is directed by Nitesh Tiwari. The second part will release in 2028.
ctx.text:
Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana , starring Ranbir Kapoor , Yash and Sai Pallavi, released in theatres on November 5. The film did great business on its opening day, setting a new record for a pre-Diwali release in India. After a dip, the film showed a sharp growth over the extended Diwali holiday period. It crossed ₹ 500 crore within 6 days of release.
Advance bookings for Ramayana opened on Dussehra, 15 days before release. By the time of its release, the film had already sold tickets worth ₹ 200 crore worldwide. The film went on to collect ₹ 64.85 crore in India on its first day of release, becoming the fourth-highest opening in Bollywood history. Friday saw a dip, and the film collected only ₹ 48.05 crore. The film picked up on Saturday with a haul of ₹ 69.80 crore. The film then earned ₹ 107 crore net on Monday and ₹ 94 crore net on Tuesday, both the highest in Indian cinema history.
Ramayana entered the elite 500-crore club on Wednesday. The latest update from Sacnilk states that Ramayana collected ₹ 39.67 crore, taking its box office collection to ₹ 604.27 crore . The film has seen a dip again but maintained momentum after the Diwali holidays, crossing the ₹ 600 crore mark. It remains to be seen how the film performs on its second weekend, and is able to improve more to cross the ₹ 700 crore mark.
Ramayana has now surpassed the lifetime haul of Chhaava , starring Vicky Kaushal and released last year, which stood at ₹ 601.57 crore. Previously, it had crossed lifetime hauls of Shah Rukh Khan's Pathaan (which stood at ₹ 544.28 crore) and Ranbir Kapoor's previous theatrical release Animal (which stood at ₹ 556.36 crore).
Ramayana is the latest adaptation of Valmiki's epic, one of the world's oldest pieces of literature. It tells the story of Lord Rama, the incarnation of Lord Vishnu and his battle against the asura king Ravana after the latter abducts his wife, Sita.
Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part film. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first released worldwide on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2028.
